# Leadership Learners

> Leadership Learners offers leadership training for organizations and communication coaching for individuals. Tammy Summers leads the training, coaching, and DISC assessment work.

There are two service paths. For managers and teams, Tammy offers group leadership training, workshops, and organizational DISC assessments focused on leadership and clearer team communication. For individuals, including neurodivergent adults and professionals, she offers one-to-one speech and communication coaching plus Student & Career DISC and Sales & Entrepreneur DISC assessments.

Tammy is a leadership trainer and coach, a full-time business professor at Imperial Valley College, and a certified member of the Maxwell Leadership Team. The About page gives her background and approach. For service fit, scope, cost, and next steps, contact her directly at (858) 603-6709 or t.summers@leadershiplearners.org. The site does not publish a price list.

The linked pages are the source for current service details. The blog contains published articles and can change independently of this file; use its index or the sitemap to find current posts.

## Services

- [Corporate leadership training](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/corporate): Group training and organizational DISC assessments for managers and teams, including work on communication, conflict resolution, delegation, and team dynamics.
- [Individual communication coaching](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/individual): One-to-one speech and communication coaching, including support for neurodivergent individuals, plus Student & Career DISC and Sales & Entrepreneur DISC options.

## About and contact

- [About Tammy Summers](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/about): Tammy's leadership background, teaching experience, certifications, and communication-focused approach.
- [Contact Tammy](https://www.leadershiplearners.com/contact): Phone and email contact options; start by sharing whether you need support for yourself or your team and what you want to improve.
